back: A convolution where the output at time t uses only values at t and earlier. Padding is added on the left only.

Name two advantages of a TCN over an LSTM.
back: Parallel training over time steps, and a known fixed memory length (the receptive field).
The block input is added to the block output, so signals and gradients flow through deep stacks.
